action: No action needed; for awareness. Use the figures to brief leadership on ransomware exposure and check leak-site monitoring for your sector.
exec: BlackFog counts record publicly disclosed ransomware attacks for a third quarter; leak-site claims also rose sharply.
plain: Security firm BlackFog says publicly disclosed ransomware attacks in Q3 2026 were the highest for any third quarter it has recorded.

key_findings: BlackFog counted 353 publicly disclosed ransomware attacks in Q3 2026, a 20% increase on Q3 2025 (293).
It counted 2,668 leak-site claims in Q3 2026, up 77% year on year; August had 999, its highest monthly total.
Qilin and The Gentlemen each claimed 347 attacks (13%); The Gentlemen had 28 disclosed attacks, more than any other named group.

summary: Security vendor BlackFog's Q3 2026 ransomware report counts 353 publicly disclosed attacks, 20% more than Q3 2025 (293), the highest Q3 total it has recorded. It also counts 2,668 leak-site claims, up 77% year on year. These are BlackFog's own counts, from its own data.
title: BlackFog Q3 2026 report counts 353 publicly disclosed ransomware attacks, highest Q3 on record

validation.note: Read BlackFog's own press release; the Business Wire copy returned 403 and VMblog was not opened. Figures are the vendor's own counts.

review.note: Compared 353/293/20%, 2,668/77%, August 999, Qilin and Gentlemen 347 (13%), Gentlemen 28, 'busiest Q3 since 2020' and date against BlackFog press release; vendor's own counts stated
